regression_test_vacuity_check.method: copied the pre-fix view (git show 52d0477:.../order-result-view.tsx -> __challenge__/old-view.tsx) and ran the identical fix2 test body against it (import path swapped only).
regression_test_vacuity_check.result: 3 of 4 tests FAIL on the pre-fix view, each on the exact reported symptom: G-1 'expected [...] to have a length of 1 but got 2' (two forbidden texts); G-2 NOT_FOUND 'expected null not to be null' on queryByText('Không tìm thấy đơn hàng'); G-2 AUTH_REQUIRED 'expected null not to be null' on queryByText(checkout.authRequired). The 4th test (network error keeps polling) passes on both views by design - it is a guard against over-fixing, not a regression test.
regression_test_vacuity_check.notes: Assertions use stepped act() per 1 s tick and count GETs on /v1/orders/o1 (toBe(2)) so the 'polling stopped' half is asserted, not just the message. G-1 additionally asserts the PAID banner survives. Minor gap: G-1 does not assert the absence of result.loadErrorTitle (the top card's title) - covered by my rerun, optional to add.

attack_matrix.columns: error in {FORBIDDEN 403, NOT_FOUND 404, AUTH_REQUIRED 401+refresh 401, NETWORK (fetch reject), S503}

rows.none (first GET fails): FORBIDDEN -> 1 alert (loadErrorTitle + checkout.forbidden), no retry, 1 GET. NOT_FOUND -> 1 alert notFound, no retry, 1 GET. AUTH_REQUIRED -> 1 alert loadErrorTitle + loadErrorBody + Retry button, NO sign-in link (see R3-1). NETWORK / S503 -> 1 alert loadError + Retry, and the hook keeps auto-polling behind the card (10 GETs / 60 s; status defaults to PENDING when order===null) - pre-existing, self-healing, harmless.
rows.PENDING: FORBIDDEN / NOT_FOUND / AUTH_REQUIRED -> exactly 1 role=alert, spinner gone, manual button gone, polling stopped at 2 GETs; AUTH_REQUIRED shows checkout.authRequired + link href=/auth/sign-in. Also via initialOrder PENDING (1 GET). NETWORK / S503 -> 0 alerts, spinner + 'Kiểm tra trạng thái ngay' stay, 7 GETs / 30 s (keeps polling). 401 with a successful refresh -> transparent retry, no card. Auto-poll exhausted at 15 attempts (16 GETs) keeps spinner+manual; manual click -> 404 -> notFound card replaces spinner (17 GETs).
rows.PAID: issue 503 -> onRetry GET x -> the order error is never rendered (no loadError/notFound/forbidden top card); exactly 1 alert in every column: FORBIDDEN -> issued.forbidden (1 checkout.forbidden); NOT_FOUND / AUTH_REQUIRED -> issued.failed 'Chưa lấy được vé điện tử' + 'Lấy vé lại' (F-13 design, see R3-3); NETWORK / S503 -> 6 issue attempts then issued.failed. GET 403 but issue #2 succeeds -> QR shown, 0 alerts.
rows.FAILED / EXPIRED / CANCELLED: initialOrder: 0 GET and 0 issue over 120 s, exactly the one status card, no error card. PENDING -> poll -> settled: polling stops at 2 GETs, one card, later 403 never fetched.
rows.recovery: PENDING -> network x3 -> PAID: error cleared (0 alerts), PAID banner, issue-tickets called once, QR rendered, polling stopped at 5 GETs. PENDING -> network -> PENDING -> 404: single notFound card at 4 GETs.

attack_matrix.duplicates: In no cell did two role=alert elements render; the PENDING card and the error card are mutually exclusive via !showErrorCard; PAID/FAILED/EXPIRED/CANCELLED branches never co-render with the error card because showErrorCard requires status === 'PENDING' when order !== null.
